<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Riya's Birthday Surprise ✨</title>
<style>
:root{--pink:#ff4f91;--gold:#ffca55;--purple:#21002f;--cream:#fff0b0}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;min-height:100%;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;color:#fff}
body{min-height:100vh;overflow-x:hidden;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 20%,#4b0766 0%,#21002f 50%,#09000f 100%);display:flex;justify-content:center}
#stars{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;z-index:0}
.star{position:absolute;background:#fff;border-radius:50%;opacity:.75;animation:twinkle 2.5s infinite alternate}
@keyframes twinkle{from{opacity:.15;transform:scale(.7)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.25)}}
.app{position:relative;z-index:1;width:min(100%,470px);min-height:100vh;padding:24px 20px 42px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center}
.topline{height:3px;width:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ff9b00,#ff4f91,#a855f7);position:absolute;top:0;left:0}
.togglebar{align-self:flex-end;display:flex;gap:8px;margin:4px 0 30px}
.pill{border:1px solid #a04ac0;border-radius:30px;padding:7px 12px;font:12px Arial,sans-serif;color:#ffd8f0;background:#27053a;cursor:pointer}
.screen{display:none;width:100%;flex:1;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;animation:fade .7s ease}
.screen.active{display:flex}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
h1,h2,p{margin-top:0}
h1{font-size:clamp(28px,8vw,40px);font-weight:normal;color:#ffbf49;text-shadow:0 0 16px #ff8b2944;margin-bottom:4px}
.kicker{letter-spacing:5px;font-size:13px;color:#e5cde9;margin:7px 0}
.name{letter-spacing:4px;font-size:26px;color:#ff8ab8;margin:0 0 26px}
.btn{border:0;border-radius:30px;padding:13px 22px;color:#fff;font-weight:bold;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#ffb21e,#ff3e92);box-shadow:0 6px 22px #ff369244;cursor:pointer;margin:10px 0;font-size:14px;transition:transform .2s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px) scale(1.02)}
.sub{font:12px Arial,sans-serif;color:#c8b2d1;letter-spacing:2px;margin:18px 0}
.envelope{position:relative;width:220px;height:150px;margin:10px auto 28px;cursor:pointer;filter:drop-shadow(0 14px 22px #0006);transition:transform .5s}
.env-back{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#ffcf58;border-radius:8px}
.env-left{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#f6b638;clip-path:polygon(0 0,50% 55%,0 100%);z-index:2}
.env-right{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#ffdc74;clip-path:polygon(100% 0,50% 55%,100% 100%);z-index:2}
.env-bottom{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#ffbd37;clip-path:polygon(0 100%,50% 45%,100% 100%);z-index:3}
.env-flap{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#ffe68c;clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,50% 62%);z-index:4;transform-origin:top;transition:transform .7s}
.seal{position:absolute;z-index:5;left:50%;top:48%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);height:36px;width:36px;border-radius:50%;background:#ff3192;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:19px;box-shadow:0 0 16px #ff3192}
.envelope.open .env-flap{transform:rotateX(180deg)}
.envelope.open{transform:translateY(8px)}
.letter{font-size:13px;color:#d6c4df;letter-spacing:2px}
.progress{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin:4px 0 20px}
.progress i{height:7px;width:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#734b7e}
.progress i.on{background:#ffb13e;box-shadow:0 0 10px #ffb13e}
.photo-stack{position:relative;width:min(270px,82vw);height:315px;margin:8px auto 18px;transform:rotate(-2deg)}
.photo-card{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#fff9f2;padding:12px 12px 52px;box-shadow:0 12px 24px #0008;transform:rotate(3deg)}
.photo-card.back{transform:rotate(-7deg) translate(-8px,7px);background:#d9d0df}
.photo-card.mid{transform:rotate(5deg) translate(5px,4px);background:#f1e6ed}
.photo{width:100%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#d7c1d8,#5a315f);overflow:hidden;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#fff;text-align:center;font:13px Arial,sans-serif}
.photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.caption{position:absolute;bottom:15px;left:10px;right:10px;color:#655061;font-style:italic;font-size:14px}
.memory-title{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:3px;color:#e7a52d;margin-bottom:8px}
.memory-count{font:11px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:2px;color:#cdb9d4;margin-bottom:10px}
.upload{font:11px Arial,sans-serif;color:#e7cce8;cursor:pointer;margin:7px 0 12px}
.upload input{display:none}
.cake{font-size:105px;line-height:1.3;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 15px #ff6b9c33);margin:12px 0}
.cake-caption{font:13px Arial,sans-serif;color:#cdb9d4;max-width:270px;line-height:1.6}
.candles{font-size:24px;letter-spacing:2px;margin-top:-6px}
.confetti{position:fixed;top:-15px;font-size:20px;pointer-events:none;animation:fall 3.5s linear forwards;z-index:5}
@keyframes fall{to{transform:translateY(110vh) rotate(600deg);opacity:0}}
.footer{font:10px Arial,sans-serif;color:#a78bb4;margin-top:30px;letter-spacing:1px}
.toast{position:fixed;bottom:20px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#4a155d;padding:12px 18px;border-radius:20px;display:none;font:13px Arial,sans-serif;z-index:10}
@media(max-height:720px){.app{padding-top:14px}.togglebar{margin-bottom:14px}.photo-stack{height:265px;width:225px}.photo-card{padding-bottom:44px}.cake{font-size:85px}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="stars"></div>
<main class="app">
  <div class="topline"></div>
  <div class="togglebar">
    <button class="pill" id="musicBtn" onclick="toggleMusic()">♫ Music: OFF</button>
    <button class="pill" onclick="toggleStars()">✦ Sparkles</button>
  </div>

  <section class="screen active" id="intro">
    <div class="envelope" id="envelope" onclick="openSurprise()">
      <div class="env-back"></div><div class="env-left"></div><div class="env-right"></div>
      <div class="env-bottom"></div><div class="env-flap"></div><div class="seal">💌</div>
    </div>
    <h2 style="font-size:15px;color:#ffdf8d;margin:0 0 8px">You have a special surprise!</h2>
    <p class="sub" id="introHint">✧ TAP THE ENVELOPE TO OPEN ✧</p>
    <button class="btn" onclick="openSurprise()">✨ Open Surprise</button>
  </section>

  <section class="screen" id="birthday">
    <h1>Happy</h1><div class="kicker">B I R T H D A Y</div>
    <div class="name" id="birthdayName">Riya</div>
    <p style="color:#d5b7df;line-height:1.7;max-width:300px">Today is all about you. May your smile shine brighter than every star in the sky. 💖</p>
    <button class="btn" onclick="showScreen('memories')">📸 View Memories</button>
  </section>

  <section class="screen" id="memories">
    <div class="memory-title">✦ MEMORY JOURNEY ✦</div>
    <div class="memory-count" id="memoryCount">MEMORY 1 OF 4</div>
    <div class="progress" id="progress"></div>
    <div class="photo-stack">
      <div class="photo-card back"></div><div class="photo-card mid"></div>
      <div class="photo-card"><div class="photo" id="photoBox"><span>📷<br><br>Add your favourite photo</span></div><div class="caption" id="photoCaption">Our first memory ❤️</div></div>
    </div>
    <button class="btn" id="nextMemory" onclick="nextMemory()">Next Memory 💗</button>
    <button class="pill" style="margin-top:8px" onclick="showScreen('wish')">Go to birthday cake 🎂</button>
  </section>

  <section class="screen" id="wish">
    <h1 style="font-size:30px">Make a Wish! 🎂</h1>
    <p class="cake-caption">Make a wish & tap the candles to blow them out!</p>
    <div class="candles" id="candles">🕯️🕯️🕯️🕯️🕯️</div>
    <div class="cake" id="cake">🎂</div>
    <button class="btn" id="blowBtn" onclick="blowCandles()">💨 Blow all candles</button>
    <p id="wishMessage" class="cake-caption"></p>
    <button class="btn" id="againBtn" style="display:none" onclick="showScreen('intro')">💌 Replay Surprise</button>
  </section>
  <div class="footer">✨ MADE WITH LOVE, JUST FOR YOU ✨</div>
</main>
<div class="toast" id="toast"></div>
<script>
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const memories=[
{caption:'Your beautiful smile ❤️', photo:'data:image/png;base64,'},
{caption:'A lovely memory 💖', photo:'data:image/png;base64,'},
{caption:'A moment to remember ✨', photo:'data:image/png;base64,'},
{caption:'Always keep smiling 🌸', photo:'data:image/png;base64,'}
];
let memoryIndex=0, blown=false, musicOn=false, audioCtx=null, starsOn=true;
function makeStars(){
 const root=$('stars');root.innerHTML='';
 for(let i=0;i<75;i++){const s=document.createElement('span');s.className='star';s.style.left=Math.random()*100+'%';s.style.top=Math.random()*100+'%';let z=1+Math.random()*3;s.style.width=z+'px';s.style.height=z+'px';s.style.animationDelay=Math.random()*3+'s';root.appendChild(s)}
}
makeStars();
function showScreen(id){document.querySelectorAll('.screen').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('active'));$(id).classList.add('active');if(id==='memories')renderMemory()}
function openSurprise(){ $('envelope').classList.add('open');$('introHint').textContent='✧ OPENING YOUR SURPRISE... ✧';setTimeout(()=>{showScreen('birthday');confetti(25)},550)}
function renderMemory(){
 $('memoryCount').textContent=`MEMORY ${memoryIndex+1} OF ${memories.length}`;
 $('photoCaption').textContent=memories[memoryIndex].caption;
 $('progress').innerHTML=memories.map((_,i)=>`<i class="${i===memoryIndex?'on':''}"></i>`).join('');
 $('photoBox').innerHTML='';
 const im=document.createElement('img');
 im.src=memories[memoryIndex].photo;
 im.alt=memories[memoryIndex].caption;
 $('photoBox').appendChild(im);
 $('nextMemory').textContent=memoryIndex===memories.length-1?'Make a Wish 🎂':'Next Memory 💗';
}
function nextMemory(){if(memoryIndex<memories.length-1){memoryIndex++;renderMemory()}else showScreen('wish')}
function loadPhoto(e){const f=e.target.files[0];if(!f)return;const url=URL.createObjectURL(f);$('photoBox').innerHTML='';const im=document.createElement('img');im.src=url;$('photoBox').appendChild(im)}
function blowCandles(){if(blown){showScreen('intro');return}blown=true;$('candles').textContent='✨  ✨  ✨';$('cake').textContent='🎂';$('wishMessage').textContent='Your wish is on its way to the stars! May all your dreams come true. 💖';$('blowBtn').style.display='none';$('againBtn').style.display='inline-block';confetti(70);playChime();$('toast').textContent='Wish sent to the universe ✨';$('toast').style.display='block';setTimeout(()=>$('toast').style.display='none',2400)}
function confetti(n){const symbols=['✨','💖','🌟','🎉','💕','⭐'];for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const e=document.createElement('span');e.className='confetti';e.textContent=symbols[Math.floor(Math.random()*symbols.length)];e.style.left=Math.random()*100+'vw';e.style.animationDuration=(2+Math.random()*2)+'s';e.style.fontSize=(12+Math.random()*16)+'px';document.body.appendChild(e);setTimeout(()=>e.remove(),4500)}}
function toggleStars(){starsOn=!starsOn;$('stars').style.display=starsOn?'block':'none'}
function playChime(){try{const C=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;audioCtx=audioCtx||new C();[523,659,784].forEach((freq,i)=>{let o=audioCtx.createOscillator(),g=audioCtx.createGain();o.frequency.value=freq;o.type='sine';g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,audioCtx.currentTime+i*.16);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.08,audioCtx.currentTime+i*.16+.02);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,audioCtx.currentTime+i*.16+.35);o.connect(g);g.connect(audioCtx.destination);o.start(audioCtx.currentTime+i*.16);o.stop(audioCtx.currentTime+i*.16+.4)})}catch(e){}}
function toggleMusic(){musicOn=!musicOn;$('musicBtn').textContent=musicOn?'♫ Chime: ON':'♫ Music: OFF';if(musicOn)playChime()}
</script>
</body>
</html>
